name: Consiva DSR Fulfillment - Test Environment (placeholder)
_note: All values here are placeholders, not real credentials or IDs from any live system. baseUrl must point at a non-production test deployment -- never at the prod docker-compose stack on this box. authToken must be a real bearer token (a signed-in person's JWT, or a service key csv_... minted with dsr:operate/dsr:config scope) from that test environment's own auth flow. requestId/actionId/evidenceId/dataSourceId/retentionRuleId should be real ids owned by the org that token belongs to, created by running this collection's folders roughly in order (1 creates a case, 5+6 verify identity, 9 or 7+connector pushes evidence, 13 builds a plan whose actions feed folder 14's actionId, 21 needs a real dataSourceId from that org's ROPA data sources, 23 a real retentionRuleId from its own PUT response). foreignRequestId should be a real id owned by a DIFFERENT org, used only to exercise the cross-org-access test requests.
